title: Peek A Boo View | 5BR Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Peek A Boo View is a luxury 5BR Seacrest Beach home near the lagoon pool. Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. 6 bikes included. Sleeps 12. Reserve today!
description_expanded: Description: Peek A Boo View by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 52 Cobia Run East Details: Searching for the perfect beach house? Look no further than Peek A Boo View. From the moment you enter the private drive of Peek-a-Boo View, you will be impressed with this three story home in Seacrest Beach. Throughout your stay, you will appreciate it all- from the tasteful, coastal decor and the decorative light fixtures, to the wood paneled doors and flooring. No detail was left undone in this brand new beach home. The grand lagoon style pool is just a short walk or tram ride away. Located towards the front of Seacrest, you won’t be far from enjoying all the amenities in the surrounding areas of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. Concierge services are available, additional beach chair set up, grocery delivery, additional bike rentals, and golf cart rentals. Everything can be arranged prior to your arrival so all you need to do is show up and start having fun! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 0.40 Miles -Parking Spaces: 2 -Dining Accommodations: Table for 10 and Bar Seating for 6 -Coffee Maker Available -Seacrest Community Pool -Propane Grill -Community Tram Service Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 5 Beds / 4.5 Baths First Floor: -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room -Half Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Shared Jack and Jill Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Shared Jack and Jill Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) Third Floor: -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 5: (2) Twin/Twin Bunk Sets with Detached Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
